invariant.subject: homestead
invariant.source: Among its provisions was a five-year requirement of continuous residence before receiving the title to the land
invariant.relation: When a land claim turned into ownership

candidates: The story is about a provision that connected a claim to land with the possibility of receiving its title: title was received before the five years of residence began. The reader should understand this as a conditional path from claim to ownership, not evidence that a particular claimant completed it.
- **Development:** Explain the stated condition: title was received before the five years of residence began.
- **Endpoint:** Clarify that the provision made continuous residence a requirement beginning after title.
